label: Three of the ten reference repos are GPL-3.0 (openhuman-main, openhuman-full, tinychannels-main) and all 21 vendored crates are GPL-3.0, so those three may be mirrored but not lifted; the other seven are MIT or Apache-2.0

tinyeventqueues is an inbound event noise pipeline (ingress, normalize, gate, coalesce, salience, attention lanes, cadence, dispatch) where every event ends in exactly one of five terminal dispositions

tinysecurity-egress is a data-egress policy: a URL canonicalization guard rejecting userinfo, percent-encoding and whitespace, plus a privacy check that rejects Unknown data categories and Sensitive-mode credentials
tinysecurity-redact bounds redaction with constants, returns a content-free change tally, and scans prompts and tool definitions as well as text
tinyjuice ships token compression as a separate loadable module with host-supplied configuration and savings attribution, keeping a 636k-line dependency tree out of the host
tinyvoice isolates the platform-specific push-to-talk hotkey in its own crate rather than branching inside the voice engine
tinydocs turns a typed validated document spec into office-format bytes, so the model never emits the file format
